title: Formovie / Fengmi projector MiProjM05 (device eva, Amlogic/droidlogic), Android TV 9 (SDK 28), build PQ3B.190705.003.2102
header:
Formovie / Fengmi projector MiProjM05 (device eva, Amlogic/droidlogic), Android TV 9 (SDK 28), build PQ3B.190705.003.2102

Apply:   TV_HOST=<projector ip> tools/disable.sh examples/formovie-mprojm05/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<projector ip> tools/restore.sh examples/formovie-mprojm05/debloat.txt com.google.android.tvlauncher
Everything is DISABLED for user 0, never uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Stock launcher: com.google.android.tvlauncher. Only other HOME claimant is com.android.tv.settings/.system.FallbackHome.
Saved Wi-Fi belongs to android.uid.system and com.google.uid.shared, not setupwraith, which does not claim HOME here.
The firmware re-enables com.google.android.leanbacklauncher at every boot; it claims no HOME, so it is left alone.
HDMI comes from com.droidlogic.tvinput, so the launcher's Inputs pill lists the one HDMI port. No tuner:
live_tv_package can be left empty.
Kept: com.fengmi.projector.imaging (focus, keystone, auto keystone; auto keystone still works with Camera2 off),
com.fengmi.fmsettings, com.fengmi.platform, com.formovie.fmutils, com.formovie.gsettings (projector settings,
voice key, USB), com.formovie.launchboard (Formovie app drawer), droidlogic services, Live Channels, Play Store and Services.
Remote ("Xiaomi RC", Vendor_2717_Product_32b9.kl): the gear button sends KEY_APPSELECT (580), mapped to
KEYCODE_ALL_APPS (284), not KEY_TAPE (384). With tvlauncher disabled it does nothing; settings_key_keycodes 284 with
HOME_KEY_SERVICE=1 makes it open Settings, but that helper stops a held Volume Up from ramping (one step per press).
Firmware updates come through TvSettings; no separate updater package.

apps.note: the webcam is driven by Formovie's own cameraservice_fm, not this app
factory test suite: disabled, never launched
